stem: Several thrips are collected, but the facility needs a species-level determination because management implications differ. What is the strongest action?
choices: Assign species from crop injury alone.
Use the darkest specimen as the representative species.
Call every specimen western flower thrips because it is common in greenhouses.
Preserve specimens and obtain qualified identification using the microscopic characters needed for species-level determination.
rationale: UC IPM notes that species-level thrips identification may require expert preparation and examination of microscopic characters; injury alone is not sufficient.
